turns.question: What was net revenue on 1 October 2026, after partner returns?
turns.answer: Net revenue (EUR) on 1 October 2026 was 964.19 EUR. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: How was that number computed?
turns.answer: The metric's description is: "Revenue minus partner returns (finance's net sales)." The query took the revenue of non-cancelled orders placed on 2026-10-01, subtracted the sum of partner return amounts recorded on 2026-10-01, and returned the difference, 964.19 EUR. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
